title: Ukrainian Corn Fritters
description: Crispy fritters filled with corn and served with a side of flatbread. A tasty Ukrainian-inspired dish.
instructions: 1. Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
2. In a bowl, mix together corn, tasty, egg, salt, and pepper.
3. Tear flatbread into small pieces and add to corn mixture.
4. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil.
5. Fry fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
6. Remove fritters from oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
7. Serve fritters hot with a side of flatbread.
